[[Aviansie]] can be assigned as a [[slayer task]] provided that players have access to the [[God Wars Dungeon]] (requiring completion of [[Death Plateau]]) and has unlocked ''Watch the birdie'' slayer perk for 80 [[Slayer reward point]]s.

Aviansie can be found in the [[God Wars Dungeon|normal]] and [[Wilderness God Wars Dungeon]]; as followers of [[Armadyl]], Armadylean [[God Wars Dungeon#God equipment|God-aligned items]] are required to make them tolerant. Aviansie have an increased sense of danger and will attack players if they are attacked, even if they're in combat with another monster. Their flying height means that they can only be harmed with ranged and magic, although [[salamander]]s and [[halberd]]s are an exception as a direct target.

Aviansie have a somewhat generous drop table that mostly revolves around [[adamantite bar]]s, [[runite limb]]s, [[ensouled aviansie head]]s and [[rune dagger|poisoned rune dagger]]s, the limbs and daggers having reasonable high alchemy price. Aviansies in the God Wars Dungeon will only drop the bars noted if the player has completed the [[Fremennik Diary#Hard|Hard Fremennik Diary]], whereas those in the Wilderness drop them noted regardless of diary completion. Though unlikely, it is possible to be killed by other players in the Wilderness, and its dangers force players to bring less than optimal gear if minimising risk.

[[Kree'arra]] and his bodyguards can be killed as alternatives for an aviansie task, but not the Armadylean-aligned [[spiritual warrior]]s, [[spiritual ranger|ranger]]s and [[spiritual mage|mages]]. Due to the general lack of popularity with aviansie, they are usually toggled off unless killing [[Kree'arra]].

While an emergency teleport is required as usual at Kree'arra, players can bank at [[Nex]]; get the Zarosian kills prior to starting the trip to start off with an optimal inventory, and use an [[ecumenical key]] to avoid wasting time on kill count. Accessing Kree'arra will require two additional inventory slots to cover a crossbow that can fire a [[mith grapple]]. Banking at the prison will require a Zarosian item to avoid getting killed, and it is recommended to gather the necessary Zarosian killcount to avoid having to kill them while returning from a trip. With max mage gear, an [[Eldritch Nightmare staff]] and optional [[lightbearer]], the player can often complete entire tasks at Kree'arra without having to bank, limited to the charges and runes in their possession.

Alternatively, players could kill [[Reanimated aviansie|reanimated aviansie]], though it could be troublesome to obtain ensouled heads as they are not killed as often.
